characters.name: Seila
characters.voice_notes: Gladias's wife, blogger on economics and culture, mother of Zven and Lily. Sharp, quick, warm but direct; in ch21 and ch23 she is furious and shouts (lines in capitals), in ch20 a determined investigator who wins people's trust.

characters.name: Vil
characters.voice_notes: Co-father in Gladias and Seila's co-family (father of Febric and Hreda, 'Uncle Vil' to Zven and Lily); calm, measured, a little tired; in a long lawsuit against his former employer.

characters.name: Lily
characters.age: child/teen (school age, exact age not given)
characters.voice_notes: Gladias and Seila's daughter; usually withdrawn and struggling at school, here bursting in excited about a good test score.

characters.name: Daia
characters.voice_notes: Co-mother (Vil's wife, 'Aunt Daia'); warm, friendly, keeps the dinner-table conversation going.

characters.name: Zven
characters.voice_notes: Gladias and Seila's young son; energetic, excitable, proud of his Helisport and physics; calls Gladias 'Dad'.

characters.name: Gladias
characters.voice_notes: Protagonist of the Veridia thread; a Keeper in the Order of Steering, husband of Seila, father of Zven and Lily. Thoughtful, earnest, a bit naive and philosophical; calm, curious, humble when wrong.

notes: No exceptions. V is Vil (not Verdow), Z is Zven (not Zei), L is Lily, D is Daia. From 21:48 on, Gladias and Seila talk over a voice call (Gladias is the remote party; the scene is from Seila's side) - Seila is angry and shouts in places (capitals). All attributions confident.
